text: Personal time-stop: slow time around you down to a complete halt, limited by stamina
description: Affects projectiles and everything else in your bubble. When your stamina runs out, everything frozen around you resumes.

status.comment: Single-player version (experiments): grip (Index/Touch squeeze, simple: menu) stops the net's world time (timescale x factor -> 0 in ~0.25 s; the image still reprojects with the head) for up to 6 s of stamina, refill 12 s; empty stamina resumes time; a new press needs >= 0.2 stamina (timestop.rs). Verified: unit test of the stamina cycle, bindings accepted on Monado, app runs. Not done: the 'bubble' (only around you, for others and projectiles) needs multiplayer/game objects; a stamina display/haptic.
